blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following form attributes is used if you want to prevent certain fields from being empty before submission?
Tap an option below to answer:
placeholder
Incorrect, give it another shot!
The placeholder attribute describes a hint (a text) on what to enter in fields.
The placeholder attribute describes a hint (a text) on what to enter in fields.
value
Incorrect, give it another shot!
The value attribute sets the initial value of a field.
The value attribute sets the initial value of a field.
required
Correct Answer!
The required attribute specifies that the input field must be filled before submitting.
The required attribute specifies that the input field must be filled before submitting.
disabled
Incorrect, give it another shot!
The disabled attribute specifies that a field is disabled. We will learn about it next.
